evals.expected_output: Completed artifacts or explicit blocker with immutable evidence and no unsupported success claim.

Real satisfaction, changed-instance, optimization and error/isolation checks passed where supported.
Sources, dependency versions, image identity and files recorded.
Ready/blocked outcome returned to caller with shared run ID and no nested campaign.

evals.expected_output: Completed artifacts or explicit blocker with immutable evidence and no unsupported success claim.

assertions.requirement: Integration repair verified with real tests.
